description: This file contains API functions for fetching project-related cost data from a backend API. It defines two exported functions: getProjectCost and getProjectCostHistorySum, which retrieve aggregated project cost and cost history sum respectively.

methods.name: getProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the aggregated cost for a specific project by projectId, calling the API endpoint /api/projects/:projectId/cost and returning an object containing projectId, cost, and currency.

methods.name: getProjectCostHistorySum(projectId)
methods.description: Fetches the total cost sum (accounting for detailed deltas) for a specific project by projectId, calling the API endpoint /api/projects/:projectId/cost-history-sum, and returning an object with projectId and cost.
